title: Canonical derived base-change morphism
statement: Let f:X\to S and g:S'\to S be morphisms of schemes, let X'=X\times_S S' with projections f':X'\to S' and g':X'\to X, so that X'\xrightarrow{g'}X over S'\xrightarrow{g}S is a cartesian square with f\circ g'=g\circ f' [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. For E in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], the canonical derived base-change morphism Lg^*Rf_*E\to Rf'_*Lg'^*E is the adjoint under Lg^*\dashv Rg_* [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint, def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image] of the composite Rf_*E\to Rf_*Rg'_*Lg'^*E\cong R(f\circ g')_*Lg'^*E=R(g\circ f')_*Lg'^*E\cong Rg_*Rf'_*Lg'^*E, whose first arrow is Rf_* of the unit E\to Rg'_*Lg'^*E of the adjunction Lg'^*\dashv Rg'_* [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] and whose isomorphisms are the canonical composition isomorphisms for derived direct images [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition]. For an open W\subseteq X with W'=(g')^{-1}(W), the same construction applied to the cartesian square formed by f|_W, f'|_{W'}, g and g'|_{W'} gives the derived base-change morphism Lg^*R(f|_W)_*(E|_W)\to R(f'|_{W'})_*L(g'|_{W'})^*(E|_W).
